description: International Paper Company is a global leader in sustainable packaging solutions, producing renewable fiber-based packaging products with manufacturing operations in North America, Latin America, Europe and North Africa. It is a New York corporation, incorporated in 1941 as the successor to the New York corporation of the same name organized in 1898, and in recent years the company has undergone significant transformation designed to simplify its operations, strengthen performance and position the business for long-term value creation. It follows the IP 80/20 performance system, a disciplined, data-driven operating model focused on simplification, segmentation, resourcing and growth, and has taken actions to drive meaningful operational improvement and increase strategic flexibility across its global portfolio, including exiting non-core businesses, investing in greenfield packaging facilities with plans for two new plants announced in 2025, optimizing internal processes, and planning to separate into two independent, publicly traded companies in North America and EMEA as announced in January 2026.
